reason: User authorized expanding initial M02 from Ridge/HGB to Ridge/ElasticNet/SVR/HGB, with three historical baselines.

preprocessing.Ridge: StandardScaler on X fit on each training split
preprocessing.ElasticNet: StandardScaler on X and y, fit on each training split; inverse y transformation for metrics
preprocessing.SVR: StandardScaler on X and y, fit on each training split; inverse y transformation for metrics
preprocessing.HGB: raw features and target; no random validation or early stopping

selection.metric: pooled MAE on three development months, per target
selection.within_family: within 1 percent of best MAE prefer first listed parameter combination; publish all results
selection.between_families: publish selected setting of each family and best historical baseline; provisional overall candidate chosen within 1 percent of best MAE, preference baseline, Ridge, ElasticNet, HGB, SVR
selection.limitations: These are development-selected scores, not independent test estimates. Family grid sizes differ. No claim of exhaustive optimization or algorithm superiority.
selection.final_tradeoff: M05 selection tolerances for maximum-hour under/overprediction remain pending development evidence

diagnostics: daily maximum with one-date tie weights
power_states: posthoc only: zero, positive rounded mean<20, rounded mean20..26, rounded mean>26; apply same definitions to previous hour
